title: Grateful Dead Live at Curtis Hixon Convention Hall on 1973-12-18
source: 3 source matrix: Soundboard (shnid 97511); AdamG's audience recording (new flat transfer); and Dan McDonald's audience recording (new flat transfer)

ai_review.summary: High‑quality matrix capture of a gorgeous show highlighted by an inspired Space > Eyes sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording is widely praised as a superb matrix that presents the concert with clarity and life, though one reviewer felt it sounded more like an audience tape. The performance itself is described as “gorgeous” and “alive,” with the Space > Eyes segue singled out as a standout moment. Overall listeners appreciate both the musical vibe and the effort put into preserving/upgrading the audio.

ai_rating.rationale: Four of five reviewers gave 4‑5 stars, highlighting a great show and strong matrix quality; weighted average (70% show, 30% recording) yields ~4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Most reviewers call it a superb matrix with excellent preservation and clarity; one comment suggests it sounds more like an audience tape, indicating slight ambiguity but no major flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is described as gorgeous and alive, with a smooth, compelling flow highlighted by the Space > Eyes transition.
